basic_info.description: Located in the heart of San Francisco's iconic North Beach neighborhood, 1869  Stockton Street offers a rare investment opportunity with a well-maintained,  six-unit apartment building in one of the city's most desirable locations. This  property is perfectly situated amidst the vibrant mix of world-class restaurants,  eclectic cafes, historic landmarks, and the cultural charm that North Beach  is renowned for. It's just steps away from the bustling streets of Columbus  Avenue, Washington Square Park, and the famous waterfront, making it an  ideal location for residents and a highly sought-after asset for investors. The building features six spacious 4-room units, each designed with flexibility  in mind. Traditionally considered 2-bedroom units with a formal dining area,  many of the current tenants have adapted the space to function as 3-bedroom  apartments. This adaptability presents a unique opportunity to cater to the  needs of a diverse and dynamic demographic. The units are individually  metered for PG&E and water, making it a low-expense property with minimal  utility overhead for the owner. A standout feature of the property is the penthouse workshop located on the  roof, offering panoramic 360-degree views of the city.
